item.title: Bella Hadid Just Walked The Prada Runway Four Times
item.description: Bella Hadid made her first, second, third and fourth catwalk appearances of the season in a single show.

item.title: Everyone At Fashion Week Is Wearing A Chanel Jacket
item.description: Is it strange that, of all items, traditional Chanel jackets have became the de-facto must-wear among fashion week’s most directional dressers? Well, yes and no.

item.title: Kate Middleton Is The Queen Of Rewears Once Again In Rainy Wales
item.description: Kate Middleton, the Princess of Wales, rewore a burgundy Alexander McQueen coat for a visit to Powys, Wales, on St David’s Day. Read on for more on Kate Middleton’s head-to-toe burgundy look.

item.title: What I Really Think of Dr.Reju-All’s PDRN Cream – The Truth Behind The Hype
item.description: The bestselling K-pharmacy brand in Korea has launched in the UK and with it, the hyped-about Advanced PDRN Rejuvenating Cream. Here is what Vogue thinks of the viral K-Pharmacy PDRN Cream.

item.title: I Slept On The Eight Sleep Smart Mattress Topper For 2 Weeks, Here’s What Happened
item.description: The new Pod 5 smart mattress topper from Eight Sleep has a wealth of health monitoring functions, all designed to increase restorative sleep. Vogue tested it for two weeks, here's what happened and how it changed our sleep.

item.title: 6 Egg-Free Breakfasts That Are Still High-Protein
item.description: Whether you suffer from the “egg ick” or not, sometimes you just need an egg break. Here are some breakfast options that pack in the protein without eggs, protein powder or processed foods.

item.title: All The Best Vintage Looks At The Brit Awards Over The Years
item.description: A whole host of stars have worn vintage at the Brit Awards, from Lily Allen to Alexa Chung. See the best vintage looks at the Brit Awards to date.

item.title: A Closer Look At Carolyn Bessette-Kennedy’s Most-Worn Accessories
item.description: Carolyn Bessette-Kennedy's pared-back approach to style has become the stuff of legend, in particular her accessories. Vogue highlights some of her best.

item.title: Jessie Buckley Plays The “Disobedient” Bride In John Galliano’s Final Maison Margiela Collection
item.description: Jessie Buckley has been climbing podiums in a series of princess-y gowns that feel entirely appropriate for the fairytale of an awards season she’s having – Dior for the Critics’ Choice Awards, still more Dior for the Globes, blue velvet Chanel for the BAFTAs. Now, though? A pivot, into John Galliano’s acclaimed final collection for Maison Margiela.

item.description: See all the celebrities at the autumn/winter 2026 shows at Milan Fashion Week.
